name: Barilla Gluten-Free Rotini Pasta (Cooked Soft)
whyItWorks: Spiral shape holds gentle olive oil or bone broth nicely. Low-fiber corn and rice starch gelatinizes thoroughly, reducing digestive workload on inflamed small bowel mucosa.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Boil for 9–10 minutes until soft. Drain, rinse lightly with warm water to remove excess sticky surface starch, and serve warm.
